title: The v1 critical-thinking skill list is unsourced
summary: Analysis, evaluation, inference, and the habits-of-mind list were not tied to Dewey or Ennis.
body: The v1 critical-thinking article lists analysis, evaluation, inference, self-regulation, and a set of intellectual virtues, and it says these skills are essential in an age of misinformation. That is a pedagogical program. John Dewey and Robert Ennis are the usual names and were not opened. The fallacy catalogs are sourced. The skill sermon is unsourced.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
